Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly asserted that Vivien Leigh was married to Peter Finch and even proposed a final answer including Finch as a spouse. This conflated a well-known affair with a marriage and introduced false information, steering the solution away from the correct, simple answer “Laurence Olivier” (Vivien Leigh’s marriages were to Herbert Leigh Holman and Laurence Olivier; she was never married to Peter Finch).
